_comment: The homepage award spotlight. To feature a different product, change `slug` to any platform slug (jotform, instrumentl, donorbox, donordock, bloomerang, grantable...) and rewrite award/verdict. Everything else on the card (price, link, reader offer) is pulled automatically from the platform page and affiliates.json. Set `show` to false to hide the card. Keep the verdict honest and specific: it is our own editorial pick, not a third-party accreditation.
verdict: One tool handles program applications, volunteer intake, event registration and scholarship forms, and the nonprofit discount is permanent rather than a first-year teaser.
